verdict.rationale: Per-PR preview environments are a fair question for a deployment platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The pack only shows generic primitives that could in principle be scripted into previews: `fly launch`, the Machines REST API, disposable VMs, and per-Sprite HTTPS URLs. It contains no evidence of pull-request-triggered environments, Git or CI integration, automatic teardown, or full-stack (app plus database) preview provisioning.
